description: This file defines a PHP class 'jpgraph' with methods to generate various types of statistical charts (bar graphs, pie charts, line graphs) for a CRM system, specifically for visualizations related to opportunities, sales stages, lead sources, and pipelines in Vtiger CRM. It includes functions for creating image maps, utilizes external libraries (Image/Graph.php, Image/Canvas.php), and references CRM modules, users, and opportunities data.

classes.name: jpgraph
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods to generate various statistical charts for CRM data visualization, including bar charts, pie charts, and line charts related to sales pipelines and opportunities.

methods.name: outcome_by_month
methods.description: Generates a horizontal stacked bar chart showing opportunity pipeline data grouped by month and sales stage for multiple users.

methods.name: lead_source_by_outcome
methods.description: Creates a stacked bar chart depicting opportunity amounts segmented by lead source and sales stage.

methods.name: pipeline_by_sales_stage
methods.description: Draws a horizontal stacked bar graph illustrating opportunity distribution across different sales stages within a date range.

methods.name: pipeline_by_lead_source
methods.description: Produces a pie chart visualizing the distribution of opportunities by lead source for selected users.
